recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait browser game titled Four Winds Avatar Quest. Preserve a top-down canvas action-collection loop: joystick/keyboard movement in a large world, collect nearby bending scrolls/forms with a learn/grab action, hold one active form, attack pursuing spirits with a forward bending arc, gain score by calming spirits, lose companion spirit HP on collision, persist a 60-entry scroll satchel, and restart after failure. Present it as an Avatar-inspired elemental quest about balance, found family, redemption, and world travel using procedural CSS/canvas art, large touch controls, readable HUD cards, and approved forest/desert audio cues.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first top-down free-roam action collection RPG loop in a single canvas.
- objective: move through a large world, collect equipment/relics with a grab action, defeat pursuing enemies with a forward attack arc, increase score, and expand a persistent collection log.
- input model: virtual joystick on the left, two large action buttons on the right, plus keyboard movement and grab/attack fallbacks.
- core loop: start menu -> spawn player, collectibles, and enemies -> explore -> learn/grab nearby item -> attack enemies -> score on defeated enemies -> survive escalating pursuit -> restart after HP depletion.
- fail/friction state: player has three HP; enemy collision removes HP with invulnerability flash; at zero HP the game enters a game-over modal with restart/menu options.

## Protected mechanics
- Canvas render/update loop, 2500x2500 roamable world, camera follow, joystick/keyboard movement, friction, boundary clamp, pickup radius, held item behavior, attack cone/cooldown, enemy pursuit, enemy collision damage, score-on-kill, random drop/spawn cadence, collection persistence, start/index/game-over/restart state flow.

## Remixed target
Four Winds Avatar Quest reframes the same mechanics as a young Avatar traveling a spirit map: collectibles are bending scrolls/forms, enemies are restless spirits, HP is companion spirit support, score is balance restored, and attacks are martial-arts bending arcs. Presentation, HUD, copy, palette, procedural background, and focal silhouette are rebuilt around elemental balance while preserving the original mechanic truth.
